people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?
translations.bsb: Where, O Lord, is Your loving devotion of old, which You faithfully swore to David?
translations.kjv: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?
translations.asv: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, Which thou swarest unto David in thy faithfulness?
